_comment: Adding a game = drop a folder in /games/ (or point url at an external build) and add an entry here. The index page renders itself from this file — no HTML editing.

games.title: Mytheder
games.blurb: Czech Cards Against Humanity. Private rooms, five-character join codes, five themed packs, 1016 cards.

games.title: Monkey Paw
games.blurb: One player makes a wish. Everyone else writes the catch that makes them regret it. Free text, no deck, nothing ever runs out.

games.title: Dungeon of Serenity
games.blurb: Side-view clone-diving shooter. Descend an endless procedural hive, gear up on cards each run, plant the nest bomb on the queen. Early prototype: movement + floor traversal only so far.
